page.layout: One block of text on one printed page: running head at the top with the page number 203 at the top right; below it, an italic title line, a verse poem with two italic titles set between its lines, and the poem's text. Handwritten ink marks run down the right margin and across the page; they are not printed and are omitted. Dark ink blots at the foot are omitted.

l.i: Fax lucens & extincta. Anima vita & mors.

main_text.l: Flammea si fuerit fax lucens, viuere fertur:
Non lucens data sed dicitur esse neci.
Spes, amor atque fides vbi sunt, mens viuit: iisdem
Orba tribus, vita dicitur esse carens.

l.i: Rhodanus obice interiecto retardatus: quod contigit

main_text.l: Vidi ego, cùm solitâ laxatus compede liber,
Linqueret vndosi spumantia tecta Lemani
Fulmineus Rhodanus solitas raptaret & vndas.
Vidi post, lapsis celso de vertice montis
Aggeribus Rhodani magnis iter interclusum,
Hic vbi IVRA caput tollit spectabile, fauces
Oppositò cum fratre premens insigniter arctas.
Ast indignatus se clausum feruidus amnis,
Conuocat vnanimes alto de flumine vires:
Tum verò furibundus abit præruptus aquæ mons,
Impete præcipiti non nota obstacula rumpens,
Fulmineósque vibrans geminato robore fluctu-
s, Edita riparum superatque repagula: donec
Allobrogum campis segetes euellat, & ipsis
Cum stabulis armenta ferat, tumulanda profundis
Gurgitibus. Vah humanæ vesania mentis
Captiui in morem Rhodani contraria fertur
In legem, Deus alme, tuam, redimire paratam
Pestiferos animi motus: quos obiice sancto
Sistere proponis: sed nescia cedere coelo
Mens, magis atque magis furit: & te iudice cogi
Téque Solone regi fugit: irritata ruítque

l.i: Homo lege Dei reuinctus. Ex Anselmo in 7. cap. epist. ad Rom.

page.notes: The handwritten ink annotations in the right margin and across the page are manuscript, not print, and are left out. The Latin verse is copied as printed; "amnis" is read from a damaged word and may be uncertain. The title "Homo lege Dei reuinctus" block sits as printed, with its second line below the first. Blots at the foot are not text.
